# SafeGo

> SafeGo is a tourist safety platform offering a blockchain-verified Digital ID, real-time safety zones, SOS alerts, and offline maps.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of SafeGo features and how to get started.
- [Sign In](/login): Sign in to your SafeGo account.
- [Sign Up](/signup): Create a SafeGo account and generate your Digital ID.
